Scene 01 pilot / system close-up and conceptual repair: Theme 'Tools work only when the handoff connects'. A simple low horizontal pipe carries just three small rectangular paper messages from an open inlet on the left toward a small open receiving tray on the right. At the center a short gap between two pipe ends is being repaired by the young man kneeling on one knee, viewed three-quarter side profile. BOTH hands grip and fit a large simple coupling sleeve onto the two ends; his concentrated face looks down at his hands. One small paper slips from the gap, an orange broken arrow shows the interrupted travel; beyond the sleeve one orange arrow continues toward the tray. Mechanism must be visually comprehensible: two horizontal pipe ends facing each other, sleeve aligns them, hands clearly at the joint. Only 3 props (pipe, sleeve, tray), no conveyor belts, no toolkit, no extra people, no coffee. Draw the man small relative to the device as a working figure with complete body visible; preserve shorts and shoes in kneeling view. Three handwritten labels: '输入' near inlet, '接上' near hands in red, '输出' by tray. Clean humorous product-sketch metaphor, no chart layout or heading.
